title: TSMC approves investments of up to $500M each in Anthropic and OpenAI
summary: 台积电董事会11月10日批准两项股权投资上限：以IPO发行价认购不超过5亿美元Anthropic普通股，以及认购不超过5亿美元OpenAI优先股。这是董事会授权，不等于资金已经投入。同一公告另批准约409.27亿美元资本支出，主要覆盖先进制程、封装及厂房等。晶圆代工龙头同时向两家模型客户配置股权，显示供应链关
investorNote: 晶圆代工龙头同时向两家模型客户配置股权，显示供应链关系可能延伸至资本层面，但公告没有说明任何排他产能或采购绑定。

fact.subject: TSMC董事会
fact.object: 分别不超过5亿美元的Anthropic与OpenAI股权投资

evidence.quote: Approved the investments in (1) Anthropic, PBC at its per share initial public offering price in an amount not to exceed US$500 million to acquire Anthropic’s common shares; and (2) OpenAI Group PBC in an amount not to exceed US$500 million to acquire OpenAI’s preferred stock.

To meet long-term capacity plans based on market demand forecasts and TSMC’s technology development roadmap, the Board approved capital appropriations of approximately US$40,926.70 million for purposes mainly including: (1) Installation and upgrade of advanced technology capacity; (2) Installation and upgrade of advanced packaging, mature and/or specialty technology capacity; (3) Fab construction, and installation of fab facility systems; (4) 2027 R&D capital investments, sustaining capital expenditures, and capitalized leased assets.

displayTitle: 台积电批准分别最多5亿美元投资Anthropic与OpenAI
narrative: 台积电董事会11月10日批准两项股权投资上限：以IPO发行价认购不超过5亿美元Anthropic普通股，以及认购不超过5亿美元OpenAI优先股。这是董事会授权，不等于资金已经投入。同一公告另批准约409.27亿美元资本支出，主要覆盖先进制程、封装及厂房等。晶圆代工龙头同时向两家模型客户配置股权，显示供应链关系可能延伸至资本层面，但公告没有说明任何排他产能或采购绑定。
